questions.question:
**In the following question, some parts of the sentence may have errors. Find out which part of the sentence has an error and select the appropriate option. If a sentence is free from error, select 'No Error'.**

Our soldiers sit in the top, (1)/ hold the ridge and can swiftly intervene, (2)/ as they pro-actively did in mid-June. (3)/ No Error (4)
questions.solution:
The erroneous part is **'1'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In part 1, the usage of an auxiliary verb is missing.
 
• The correct auxiliary verb should be 'can'.
 
• Here, 'Can' shows the possibility of the action {which is the main verb}.
 
• In the given sentence, the possibility is 'hold the ridge' and 'sit in the top'. 

**So the correct answer is-** *Our soldiers **can** sit in the top, hold the ridge, and can swiftly intervene, as they pro-actively did in mid-June.*

questions.question:
In the following question, some part of the sentence may have errors. Find out which part of the sentence has an error and select the appropriate option. If a sentence is free from error, select 'No Error'.

Earlier in June, Chinese troops (1)/have destroyed two of the old (2)/unmanned "self-help bunkers". (3)/ No Error (4)
questions.solution:
The correct answer is '**2**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The present perfect tense in part 2 is incorrect
 
• It must be replaced with **simple past **as the activity had taken place earlier.
 
• 'Have' will be removed and it will become **'Chinese troops destroyed two**...'.
 
• Correct sentence- *Earlier in June, Chinese troops destroyed two of the old unmanned "self-help bunkers". *

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

questions.question:
**In the following question, the sentence given with blank to be filled in with an appropriate word. Select the correct alternative out of the four and indicate it by selecting the appropriate option.**

The unit is comparatively ______ to install and cheap to operate.
questions.solution: The correct word here must portray the positive side of the unit. Thus ‘easy’ is the correct word.

questions.question:
In the following question, the sentence given with blank to be filled in with an appropriate word. Select the correct alternative out of the four and indicate itby selecting the appropriate option.

Rohan and Sohan are brothers but the ______ is very poor.
questions.solution: The only word that makes sense here is ‘latter’ which means ‘denoting the second or second mentioned of two people or things.’ The other words cannot fit here. Thus option 4 is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Rearrange the parts of the sentence in correct order.

I was

**P: **of the family

**Q: **as a member

**R: **accepted by John
questions.solution: R must be the first statement as it states by whom it was accepted. Q follows R as it states as what the person was expected. P is the last part as it states the fact member of what. Thus option 3 is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Rearrange the parts of the sentence in correct order.

Earth is considered

P: suitable for the life

Q: existence in the whole universe

R: as the only planet
questions.solution: R is the first statement as it states what is Earth considered to be. P follows R as the adjective ‘suitable’ is present in P.Q follows P as the word ‘existence’ is mentioned. Thus option 4 is the correct answer.

questions.question: Government to ______ and control
questions.solution: The word ‘cuddle’ means ‘hold close in one's arms as a way of showing love or affection’ and crimes cannot be cuddled. The correct word here is ‘handle’ which means ‘to deal with.’ The word ‘dwindle’ means ‘decrease’ but does not fit here. The word ‘fiddle’ means ‘touch or fidget with something in a restless or nervous way’ and does not fit here.

questions.question: The ______ and frequency
questions.solution: The word ‘number’ fits here conveying the meaning that the crimes are increasing every day. Crimes cannot be associated with the other words here in this context.

questions.question: **Increasing day by ______.**
questions.solution: The correct word here is ‘day’ as ‘day by day’ means ‘on each successive day; gradually and steadily.’ The other words cannot fit here.

questions.question: **It has ______ the confidence level of women**
questions.solution: The previous sentence mentions the deterioration of the status of women in the country. Thus option 1 is incorrect here. The correct word is ‘decreased’ that conveys a proper meaning here. The word ‘neutralized’ means ‘make (something) ineffective by applying an opposite force or effect’ and ‘initiated’ means ‘began.’

questions.question: We should not ______ the government
questions.solution: The correct word here is ‘blame’ as it means ‘to accuse someone’. The other options do not convey a proper meaning here. The word ‘inflame’ means ‘provoke or intensify (strong feelings, especially anger) in someone.’
